                                 5           1.      This is a class action lawsuit brought by Plaintiff, and others similarly situated, who

                                 9    other contaminants. Plaintiff and the putative class suffered economic damages due to Defendants’

                                 10   misconduct and seek injunctive relief and full restitution for the purchase price of the contaminated

                                 11   toothpaste products.
